questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

Penguin : Chick :: Duck : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic:** Animal and its young one.**

Here,

Penguin : Chick → **Chick** is the young one of a Penguin.

Similarly,

Duck : Duckling → **Duckling** is the young one of a Duck.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question: Six people Alice, Bob, Carol, David, Emily, and Frank are sitting on a circular table facing towards the centre. David sits between Alice and Emily. Carol sits to the immediate right of Bob. Frank and Alice are not neighbors. Carol is an immediate neighbour of Frank. Who sits to the immediate right of Emily?
questions.solution:
**Given:** Six people Alice, Bob, Carol, David, Emily, and Frank are sitting on a circular table facing towards the centre. 

1) Carol sits to the immediate right of Bob.

2) Carol is an immediate neighbour of Frank.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b01b5dfbed738c2a50c69cbc40fe3d02c2c253b21849256bc72e69e08a46ca3d.png] 

3) David sits between Alice and Emily.

4) Frank and Alice are not neighbors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79404406d44b64ec8df0087a7dc11523331047b3fe6494db43000c70ba69196d.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement David sits to the immediate right of Emily.

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statement I : **All curtains are beds.

**Statement II : **Some beds are chairs.

**Statement III : **Some chairs are not tables.

**Conclusion I :** Some chairs are tables.

**Conclusion II :** Some chairs being curtains is possible.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ab7a5612caa255f036223256ff4e6a45e2b83f82856c8605b92dd5806132fe7.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some chairs are tables → Does not follow (As some chairs are not tables. As some part of the chairs cannot be tables, so the left part can be tables but cannot be proved, therefore it is false.)

II. Some chairs being curtains is possible → **F**ollow (As all curtains are beds and some beds are chairs. As whole curtains comes in beds which has some part common with chairs, therefore some chairs can be curtains is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3"

questions.question: Five friends Pooja, Bhawna, Charu, Geeta and Hema are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre. Charu is not the immediate neighbour of Bhawna. Bhawna is second to the left of Hema. Geeta is the immediate neighbour of Bhawna and Hema. Who is sitting to the immediate left of Charu?
questions.solution:
**Given:** Five friends Pooja, Bhawna, Charu, Geeta and Hema are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre.

1) Bhawna is second to the left of Hema.

2) Geeta is the immediate neighbour of Bhawna and Hema. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9cc5a1eebaf27ef8b92b6c9bb9fd06870e445f2d56c7148e91cb0512eea68a9b.png] 

3) Charu is not the immediate neighbour of Bhawna.

After positioning Charu only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. Pooja.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cfbef3d9cac0e591efe004efc6477c8ec6083a0567cfeee2e9584b8835664048.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement Hema is sitting to the immediate left of Charu.

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.

Arrange the given words in the sequence in which they occur in the dictionary.

1. Light

2. Like

3. Lift

4. Life

5. Lignite
questions.solution:
The correct Dictionary order is:

4. Li__**fe**__

3. Li__**ft**__

1. Li__**gh**__t

5. Li__**gn**__ite

2. Li__**k**__e

So, the correct order are: '**4, 3, 1, 5, 2**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
